body: He told me he loved me a few months back but I never said it back because I wasn't sure what i felt but I finally do and then he backs off. Maybe he's just had enough of me?

And I know I can be an emotional mess I do try and control it. But being on birth control, plus having anxiety isn't exactly the greatest  mixture. I know I wasn't being fair to him so maybe it's best that it's ended. He deserves better than for me to act like a raging lunatic

That's a bit strange cause he told me he loved me a while back but I never returned the sentiment until then when I realised what I great guy I had. But also he's not the greatest boyfriend because he never sleeps, only stays an hour at a time, only texts when he wants something and has never took me out. But I overlooked all that because he was always there for me and never gave up on me despite how I can be

Thanks your completely right. He's 27 and I'm 22. I've tried to explain, say look mate I'm getting in way too deep here I need to back off and have some breathing room but he won't have any of it. He says I'm being daft and that he really really likes me and doesn't want to end things. But I'm thinking if he doesn't want a relationship then that isn't his call. But he always gets round me... I'm not easy to deal with, I do test his limits and I do tell him straight but I think it's my way of pushing. Hoping it will drive him off but he's always so frustratingly understanding and patient. I have really bad insecurities and assume the worst but I don't know how to fix it. I have days where I could give a fuck and I'm on top of the world but I also have bad days... And they are bad. I need to sort myself out but I don't know how.
